fixed_interval: Centered six-bin interval in first 30-bin chromosome, zero-based bins12..17 inclusive
selected_interval: Actual HMM run with largest absolute observed mean log((y+.5)/(E+.5)), including neutral runs; stable first tie
null_target: Systematic mean mu_I=0, not realized latent mean or posterior state
primary_family: New simultaneous procedure, three conditions times two interval selections; one-sided exact binomial undercoverage at .95, Holm six; two-sided Clopper-Pearson intervals Bonferroni six at family confidence .95
legacy_family: Same six endpoints for original reported SE, separately labeled comparator replication; no joint twelve-endpoint claim
power_effect_unit: ProfileParams default beta times natural-log(1.5), the default gain RNA-state separation; not a DNA effect
power_signal_support: Fixed six-bin interval12..17; elsewhere systematic effect zero; selected target equals exact overlap fraction times systematic effect
power_seed_namespace: [20261107,10,condition_index,replicate]; common latent draws across effect levels; Poisson count draws share generator state across methods
power_inference: Secondary descriptive operating curves, no power threshold, no addition to primary coverage family
model_contract: Oracle supplied Gaussian log-intensity covariance and independently specified median expected intensity; no reference estimation or biological validation
failures: Missing/nonfinite required estimates, NaN intervals, incomplete endpoint counts and exceptions fail execution; infinite interval endpoints are legitimate and reported
adaptation: No tuning, seed changes, threshold changes or retrospective case selection
